title: SLOW English for A2 High Beginners --- How COLORS make me feel?🌈

header.titleZh: A2 高級初學者慢速英語 --- 顏色讓我感覺如何？ 🌈
header.titleEn: SLOW English for A2 High Beginners --- How COLORS make me feel?🌈

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I will talk about colors.
sentences.tc: 今天我要談談顏色。

sentences.en: My favorite color is purple purple reminds me of the sky it reminds me of the sunset and the purple blue orange and red sky it also reminds me of my childhood.
sentences.tc: 我最喜歡的顏色是紫色，紫色讓我想起了天空，它讓我想起了日落，紫色、藍色、橙色和紅色的天空，它也讓我想起了我的童年。

sentences.en: My childhood bedroom had Tinkerbell bed sheets I had purple Tinker belt bed sheets and green Tinkerbell bed sheets.
sentences.tc: 我童年的臥室有小叮噹床單，我有紫色叮叮噹床單和綠色小叮噹床單。

sentences.en: My favorite bed sheets as a kid I also always had purple clothes when I was younger I only ever wanted purple clothes.
sentences.tc: 我小時候最喜歡的床單我也總是有紫色的衣服當我年輕的時候我只想要紫色的衣服。

sentences.en: What is your favorite color what does it remind you of maybe a special memory or a special time now?
sentences.tc: 你最喜歡什麼顏色，它讓你想起什麼，也許是一段特別的記憶或一段特別的時光？

sentences.en: I use a lot of light colored clothes light colors like white yellow orange light green.
sentences.tc: 我用了很多淺色的衣服，像是白色、黃色、橘色、淺綠色。

sentences.en: I think my skin tone suits lighter colors what colors suit you best every color makes me feel different every color has a different vibe that's.
sentences.tc: 我認為我的膚色適合淺色，什麼顏色最適合你，每種顏色讓我感覺不同，每種顏色都有不同的氛圍。

sentences.en: I feel my best when I'm wearing light clothing.
sentences.tc: 當我穿著輕便的衣服時，我感覺最好。

sentences.en: They make me feel happier.
sentences.tc: 他們讓我感覺更快樂。

sentences.en: Sometimes less stressed whenever I see someone wearing Red Clothing I think to myself wow.
sentences.tc: 有時候，每當我看到有人穿著紅色衣服時，我就會想，哇，壓力減輕了。

sentences.en: He is very confident because I think the color red is a very confident color.
sentences.tc: 他非常有自信，因為我認為紅色是一種非常自信的顏色。

sentences.en: I don't know what it is about the color red that is so intense and Powerful it makes any person who wears it stand out.
sentences.tc: 我不知道紅色為何如此強烈和強大，讓任何穿著它的人脫穎而出。

sentences.en: They stand out in a crowd.
sentences.tc: 他們在人群中脫穎而出。

sentences.en: I like to wear red.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡穿紅色。

sentences.en: I couldn't bear to live with red walls around me I think it would make me feel overwhelmed and stressed it is too much red blue however is a calming color blue.
sentences.tc: 我無法忍受周圍有紅牆，我認為這會讓我感到不知所措和壓力，紅藍色太多了，但藍色是一種平靜的顏色。

sentences.en: Walls around me make me feel peaceful and calm.
sentences.tc: 我周圍的牆壁讓我感到平靜和平靜。

sentences.en: Do you agree or disagree?
sentences.tc: 你同意還是不同意？

sentences.en: If you disagree.
sentences.tc: 如果你不同意。

sentences.en: What do you think is a calming color I personally love the combination of purple with orange it reminds me of the sunset those two colors work together so well?

sentences.en: I love seeing huge Landscapes like Farms.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡看到像農場這樣的巨大景觀。

sentences.en: I like Farms because my grandpa has a farm.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡農場，因為我的爺爺有個農場。

sentences.en: He has a huge Farm in Nebraska it is green as far as the eye can see no matter.
sentences.tc: 他在內布拉斯加州有一個巨大的農場，無論如何，它都是綠色的。
